cases.description: A repository needs low-risk consistency and hygiene improvements without changing behavior.
A cleanup pass must be updated after one candidate file is found to be generated rather than handwritten.
expected: Removes or adjusts the planned edit
Explains the cleanup delta without expanding scope

cases.description: A stale-looking file has unclear ownership and no reliable evidence that it is safe to delete.
expected: Records the missing ownership or usage evidence
Avoids representing deletion as low risk without proof

cases.description: While cleaning the repository, the engineer discovers an architectural inconsistency that would require redesign to resolve.
expected: Captures the larger issue as follow-up work
Completes only the authorized hygiene changes

cases.description: The request is to add new behavior rather than perform behavior-preserving cleanup.
expected: Declines to label new feature work as cleanup
Routes toward the appropriate implementation workflow
Avoids hiding behavior change inside a hygiene request
prohibited: Introducing new product behavior under the banner of repository cleanup
